Helicopter UH-1B 63-08694

Unit: HA(L)-3
Incident number: 69121414.KIA
UTM grid coordinates: YS015690 (map lookup key: Grid Reference 48PYS015690)
Date: 12/14/1969
South Vietnam
The helicopter Continued Flight.
Summary: Seawolf 313 of Detachment 2 crashed on a low-level reconnaissance; one crewman died.
War Story: Returning at dawn from a patrol over the Long Tau channel, Seawolf crashed into the water near YS015690. The aircraft crashed close to the bank; three men swam to shore.
